verdict.rationale: Flagright is a SaaS compliance API platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence shows only official Python and Node/TypeScript API clients, Postman access, OpenAPI downloads, and a docs MCP server. None of these is a command-line tool, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
